lines.text: In the third year of the drought, the LORD told Elijah to present himself to Ahab, and rain would follow.
Obadiah, in charge of Ahab's palace, feared the LORD and had hidden a hundred prophets in caves with food and water.
Ahab sent Obadiah to search every spring and valley for grass, and the two went off together.

wrong_details.true: Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went the other way by himself

lines.text: Elijah met Obadiah, who fell facedown and feared Ahab would put him to death if he told Ahab Elijah was there.
Elijah promised to meet Ahab tomorrow and told him to gather all Israel and the prophets of Baal at Mount Sinai.
